name: beach-flash-fisheye
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:

· PHOTOGRAPHY: a hyper-sharp editorial close-up shot with a wide-angle / near-fisheye lens held very close, mixing harsh midday sun with hard fill-flash — bulging perspective, subject pushed right up to the frame.
· GROUND: a sunny open beach — bright blue sky up top, blue ocean surf and pale golden sand receding behind.
· LIGHT: brutal direct sun plus on-camera flash, wet sweaty glossy skin with sharp speculars, crisp hard shadows, sun-flare warmth.
· PALETTE: hot bubblegum pink, sky and sea blue, tan sand and sun-tanned skin, with a pop of lime green.
· SIGNATURE TREATMENT: extreme close proximity distortion, beads of sweat and drips, visible pores and freckles, candid squinting energy.
· MOOD: sun-baked, playful, hedonistic summer editorial.
· GRAIN: ultra-crisp and high-resolution, punchy saturated colour, minimal grain.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
